en: A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a large, single‑storey Victorian-era club building with multiple chimneys, verandahs and decorative gables. A flag flies from a tall flagpole on the roof. In front, there is a street scene with small trees, a horse and cart, and several people walking near the fence. The caption at the bottom identifies the building as the Settlers Club in Mildura and credits the publisher.
